items.rationale: Sections 7.1.10 and 5.2.6(b) preserve cover for assessing the cause and extent of the loss despite gradual pipe ageing. Allow €300 gross for one ordinary assessment, below the €3,000 event cap.

items.description: Indoor leak detection with technician and vehicle
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.10 and 5.2.6(a), (c) cover locating the porous sections and one vehicle charge. Allow €390 gross for testing and technician time, plus €70 gross for travel, below the respective limits of €1,000 and €83.30 gross.

items.description: Floor and skirting removal, preparation and disposal
items.rationale: Section 7.1.10 excludes reinstatement and debris removal for moisture damage from gradual leakage. The combined line describes whole-floor work, with no separately identified access work necessary to repair the leaking pipe sections.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes provisions for contractor personnel. No amount for the three catering units is payable.
Section 7.1.10 excludes the moisture remediation otherwise covered under 7.1.7. The bundled drying, labour, dust protection and disinfection do not repair the leaking pipe sections.
Section 7.1.10 excludes the underlying drying work, and 7.1.7(b) independently excludes electricity billed separately in addition to a lump-sum drying charge. None of the 2,412.1 kWh is payable.
